Name: (AT) Pride Rugs
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]It's officially June, and you know what that means! Pride mods! I'm here to deliver some lovely rugs depicting pride flags for our wonderful community.

[size=4]Installation and Removal
[/size]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] if you haven't already, this mod won't work without it!
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip and put the file where you put the rest of your Stardew Valley mods in your Mods folder.
4. Launch game!
(5. If you would no longer like to use this mod, all you've gotta do is delete the file from the Mods folder! Easy as that.)[/font][font=Tahoma]
